استهدمت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْدَمْتُ (istahdamtu) /is.tah.dam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# اِسْتَهْدَمْتَ (istahdamta) /is.tah.dam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# اِسْتَهْدَمْتِ (istahdamti) /is.tah.dam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# اِسْتَهْدَمَتْ (istahdamat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
